create_Pix2StructProcessor: create a Pix2StructProcessor instance with an image_processor and tokenizer for multimodal encoding
call_Pix2StructProcessor_with_images: call the Pix2StructProcessor to encode images and produce pixel_values for the model
call_Pix2StructProcessor_with_text: call the Pix2StructProcessor with text input to tokenize and return text_encoding for the model
call_Pix2StructProcessor_with_images_and: call the Pix2StructProcessor with both images and text to produce combined pixel_values and decoder_input_ids
use_Pix2StructProcessorKwargs: use Pix2StructProcessorKwargs to configure text and images processing options like max_patches and add_special_tokens
